name: Merritt Reservoir SRA - Willow Cove Campground
Calamus Reservoir SRA - Valley View Flat Campground
Swanson Reservoir SRA - Lake View loop
why: Not a separate place: ReserveAmerica park 234151 loop LAKE VIEW (read 2026-11-05) puts its 8 sites (045-052, GIS centroid 40.15086,-101.06823) 0.48 km from the nearest Spring Canyon site (042) and 0.72 km from Spring Canyon's site centroid, on a short spur off the same SRA access road that serves Spring Canyon (Esri World Imagery, rendered 2026-11-05) - under the ~1 km / own-entrance bar, so it is covered by 2741 Swanson Reservoir SRA - Spring Canyon Campground (whose pin is only 0.43 km away).

name: Miller Creek - Lewis and Clark SRA
Willow Springs RV Park & Campground
why: Private park with no operator website, no booking page and no RV Life listing: only directory records (AAA 'call for rates', The Dyrt unclaimed/not bookable, 1 review 2025-05, priceLow $0), and Google Maps (gm.py 2026-11-05) shows 4.2 from 12 reviews, phone 308-750-1364, no website - under the 25-review floor, so neither the price nor the presence indicator is met (curation doc private rule, AWH 2026-10-14). MHVillage lists the same address (46854 Willow Springs Rd) as 'Willow Springs Mobile Home Park', and Esri imagery at 41.7814,-99.0985 (300 m frame, rendered, 2026-11-05) shows a small tree-shaded cluster of parked trailers/RVs and mobile homes - a likely long-stay park as well.

name: Calamus Lodge Campground (now Calamus Motel & RV)
kind_of_no: long-stay park (nights not really for sale)
why: Mostly annual-lease park failing long-stay test 2 and with no price indicator: the operator's last readable page (calamuslodge.com/campground.php, Wayback 2026-05-08) says '25 long-term shaded camp sites ... only rented annually' (status FULL, 'call to join the waiting list'), plus '6 short-term campsites which have a 2-night minimum stay' with water and electric, status not shown, 'Please call for price' - no posted nightly rate, no booking site, no RV Life listing (Algolia park index, 2026-11-05) and not in the Good Sam directory. calamuslodge.com now redirects to an unrelated apartments site (commercialsquareapartments.com, 2026-11-05); Google Maps names the business Calamus Motel & RV, LLC (4.6 from 57 reviews, 308-346-4331) with a new site calamusmotelandrv.com that refused every automated read (Cloudflare 403 / 'Too Many Requests', 2026-11-05). On the fence + mostly seasonal + iffy = drop (AWH 2026-10-31).

name: Dad's Calamus East
why: Private: a fuel station / convenience store (Dad's Calamus East, 220 N 13th Ave) with seven full-hookup camper sites on the east side of its lot (land.com / LoopNet / AcreValue sale listings, read 2026-11-05) - no operator website, no booking page, no RV Life or Good Sam listing, no posted rate; Google Maps (gm.py 2026-11-05) 4.1 from 16 reviews, phone 308-346-5567, no website - under the 25-review floor, so neither the price nor the presence indicator is met (curation doc private rule, AWH 2026-10-14). The only listing that names it as camping is the City of Burwell camping page (name + phone only).

name: Clyde City Park
why: No source confirms designated RV sites or current overnight camping, checked 2026-11-05. (1) City of Clyde site (clydekansas.org, Community Services page in the Wayback captures of 2016-02, 2024-03 and 2026-05; the live domain refuses connections) describes only 'two parks with playground equipment', a pool, ball field, tennis, pickleball and basketball, and never mentions camping. (2) Cloud County Tourism's Stay page lists Rock Island RV Park as Clyde's only RV option and omits the city park. (3) Google Maps 'Clyde City Park' (196 Perrier St, 39.59485,-97.40408) is a 'Park' with no phone, 4.4 from 11 reviews; the 5 visible (1-5 yrs) are about the playground, basketball court, bathrooms and the demolition derby, none about camping, and the limited view hid the other 6. (4) The only camping claims are aggregators repeating Ultimate Campgrounds data from 'November 2016' (CampgroundTour: '2 sites', '6 electric', $0, no toilets; AllStays: '6 sites ... Tents'), which contradict each other. RV Life does not list it. Esri imagery (2026-11-05, 160 m frame) shows an ordinary town park with no visible RV pads or pedestals.

name: Tuttle Creek State Park - South Randolph Area
Webster State Park (Lake View)
why: Part of 2087 Webster State Park (stays in it): Lake View's 10 water/electric sites (068-077, campitks loop 510317, read 2026-11-06) have no entrance of their own from a public road. Their short spur leaves the unnamed paved park drive (OSM way 13224958) that runs ~2.2 km along the north shore between the 9 Road corner, where the west cluster is entered, and the end of 10 Road at the park's east entry (Esri imagery + OSM, 2026-11-06). The loop is mid-drive, 0.97 km from Hill Top's nearest pad and 1.08 km from Rock Point's, inside KDWP's single 'Oldtown Area'. 2087's note and site counts already include it.

name: Simple Stay RV Park
why: No live web presence (checked 2026-11-06): simplestayrvpark.com (and www., http, any path) 301-redirects to facebook.com/simplestayrvpark (Facebook is not a website); no booking page found on any engine; the Google Maps place at 614 Peace St (38.52921,-99.30815, phone 785-222-4107) shows no rating at all, so 0 reviews against the 25+ needed (the same gm.py run read Danny Elliott Park's 4.4/23 fine). It has a price indicator (RV Life 270180: $ tier, unrated, 16 sites), but the private rule needs both price and presence.

name: Lodder Up & Camp - Thomas Hill
why: Private park RV Life doesn't list (Algolia park index, query 'Lodder' + 6 km radius, 2026-11-07: only the Marceline park 260021) and not in the Good Sam directory (trip_data/goodsam_parks.json, 2026-11-07), so it needs the fallback quality signal (curation doc: Google/Campspot/Campendium/Dyrt >= 4.0 over ~25 reviews, or Good Sam >= 8.5); Google shows 5.0 from only 2 reviews (allcampsandparks Google mirror, 2026-11-07; the p3-314 verifier saw 5.0/10) - under the 25-review floor. Price and presence indicators pass (operator page lodderupandcamp.com/copy-of-marceline posts $35/night, contact page phone 660-815-1583, ParkWithUs booking page), and the Marceline sibling's 5*/$$ (23 reviews) belongs to a different property. Opened May 2024 and pitched partly to Thomas Hill Power Plant spring/fall outage crews.

name: Overnight Campground
why: Town of St. Paul news post 'Campgrounds Now Open!' (May 23 2025, archived 2025-10-07; the live URL now 404s): 'Reservations for the Overnight Campground are available by phone request only, as this site is not open daily. It is primarily available during weekend community events such as recreational tournaments and Rodeo Week.' Its Campspot park record (overnightcamp, id 4933, read 2026-11-10) says 'PARK IS OPEN BASED ON EVENTS AND SCHEDULING', and the availability API answered 'Park is closed for your dates' on every 2026 summer night probed (Jun 9, Jul 14, Jul 25, Jul 31, Aug 11, Sep 15), while Iron Horse's record on the same API showed free sites on Jul 14. The town's campgrounds pages (read 2026-11-10 in a headless browser) still list it with a May 15 - Sep 23 season, 24 powered / 16 unpowered sites at C$34 / C$24 and phone 780-614-4244, but say nothing about walk-up nights. It is a different place from 9066: 4800 55 Street, behind the RCMP detachment (Google: 4806 55 St, 53.9907,-111.3106) on the west end of town, about 2.7 km W of 9066's pin; Esri 2022 and 2024 imagery show a small gravel loop of grass sites with a central building at about 53.9897,-111.3108, with no rigs in either August capture. Google Maps has no listing of its own: every Overnight Campground query resolved to St. Paul Iron Horse Campground (4012 53 Ave, 53.99598,-111.26979, 4.4 on 47 reviews).

name: Shell City Landing Campground - Huntersville State Forest
Cross Ranch State Park - Governors Centennial Loop
Stump Lake Park Campground
why: Operator campground map posted on Nelson County's Stump Lake page (Stump_Lake_Park_Campground_Map-2013_Web.jpg, read 2026-11-12) numbers sites 1-131 in six sections. Only 'Cottonwood Corner Campsites (Temporary)' is marked for non-seasonal use: sites 77-79 and 94-100 (10) plus 3 primitive sites. That is 10 of 131 (7.6%), or 13 of 134 counting the primitive sites (9.7%), so under 10%. Park Rules (nelsonco.org Park Rules.docx, read 2026-11-12) put lessees on 'permanent camper sites' with sheds, decks and gazebos, and new lessees come off a waiting list. RV Life lists 10 sites; a 2015 RV Life reviewer: '95% are seasonal'.

name: Lake Tschida - Crappie Creek Campground (Grant County)
Lake Tschida - Southside, Hawabesi & Gilligan's Hilltop (Grant County)
Lake Tschida - Koehlers Point Campground (Grant County)
Lake Tschida - Schatz's Point Campground (Grant County)
Lake Tschida - Sled Creek Campground (Grant County)
Lake Tschida - Gilligan's Hilltop (Grant County)
why: Part of the Lake Tschida - Southside, Hawabesi & Gilligan's Hilltop entry (lake-tschida-hawabesi-southside.json): its four full-hookup sites are ~150 m from Hawabesi and ~450 m from Southside off the same access and Schatz Station (laketschida.org map, read 2026-11-12), not a separate campground.

name: Lake Tschida - Hidden Shelter Horse Campground (Grant County)
why: laketschida.org/hidden-shelter-horse-camp (read 2026-11-12): 'hidden shelter horse campground - primitive group camping', four sites booked together at $56 with four 12'x12' horse pens; 'the only campground at Lake Tschida that will accommodate horses'.

name: KCDC Campground
why: 2026-11-12: the only sources are the City of Kulm campground page (kulmnd.com/kulm-campgrounds.html: 'KCDC Campground: 701-647-2878', phone only) and the ND HHS licensed RV park list 07.17.2025 row 197 (KCDC PARK, 6 Main Ave N, owner KULM COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT CORP., 7 lots, inspected 4/24/2025). The licence address is the Kulm Clinic building downtown (Google Maps 'Kulm Clinic South Central Health', 6 Main Ave N, 46.30302,-98.94865), and neither Esri 2021-05-24 nor NAIP 2023-06-18 imagery shows RV lots there or anywhere else in town that is not the city campground or Pesek's lot. No Google Maps place, no OSM feature, no rate, hookups, season or site description anywhere; the phone is listed for Kulm Hardware (3 Main Ave N). Location, fee model, rig fit and current operation cannot be confirmed, so no pin can be placed without guessing.

name: Pesek Campground
kind_of_no: no web presence (private; no price or presence indicator)
why: 2026-11-12: the City of Kulm page (kulmnd.com/kulm-campgrounds.html) gives only 'Pesek Campground: 701-320-3799'. OSM way 874194294 (edited 2026-04-24) maps it as a ~35 x 35 m sand lot at 46.29768,-98.94912, operator Ben Pesek, fee=yes, reservation recommended, no showers, static_caravans=yes. No website, no posted rate, no booking engine, no RV Life listing, and no Google Maps place (gm.py on 'Pesek Campground Kulm ND' and 'Camp Kulm Kulm ND' both resolve to the city's Kulm Campground, 3.6/8). A private park needs a price indicator AND a presence indicator; it has neither. Nightly vs long-term share, hookups and rig fit are also unknowable from any source.

name: Kulm-Edgeley Dam (Kulm Dam WMA)
kind_of_no: wma allowance, no designated campground found
why: 2026-11-12: no operator names a campground at Kulm-Edgeley Dam. The camping right there is ND Game and Fish's general WMA allowance on the 38-acre Kulm Dam WMA ('Most WMAs are ideal for ... primitive camping', 10-day limit; gf.nd.gov/wma and /wma-listing, August 2026), not a designated campground. Not on the ND HHS licensed list (07.17.2025). Not on Google Maps (a search for the campground lands on 13574 Edgeley Campground), The Dyrt, Campendium or RV Life. The G&F 2022 contour map and its facility layer show only a ramp, a dock and a vault toilet (Kulm Rod & Gun Club), a G&F rock pier and the dam, with no camping symbol. Imagery shows a mown lawn in a shelterbelt south of the lake with picnic structures, but no pads, pedestals or RVs. The only 'campground' trace is the ndtourism title, which is never a source; MapQuest and countyoffice list 'Kulm Edgeley Dam Campground' at a Kulm street address marked CLOSED.

name: Clemens Family Campground
why: 2026-11-12: 'Clemens Family Campground' is a directory name for the Noonan Lions Club campground, not a separate private park. Google Maps resolves the name to the Lions campground place (48.8860077,-103.0063517, 505 Main St, 3.5 on 2 reviews, 47 m from 6004's pin); the ndtourism listing's pin (48.886477,-103.005819, seen as a search snippet only, ndtourism never read) is 90 m from 6004; wheretostayamerica.com (undated, (c) 2024) says it is 'Operated and maintained by the Noonan Lions Club'. No other trace: no operator site, no own Google listing, not on RV Life, not on the ND HHS licensed list (07.17.2025; Divide County's only Noonan row is NOONAN LIONS RV PARK, 7 lots).

name: North Gold RV Park
why: Google Maps (read 2026-11-12) marks North Gold RV Park, 9551 103rd St NW, Columbus, 'Permanently closed', with no website, 3 reviews from 7-8 years ago (one: 'No such place. Bogus empty lot'), and posting turned off. It is on neither RV Life nor Good Sam (Algolia indexes, 2026-11-12). The only other traces are an expired 2013 RVParkStore for-sale listing (20 full-hookup lots, built 2013 for the Bakken oil boom, 'average lot rent $650', which reads as monthly) and an unreviewed The Dyrt stub pinned 68 km away. So it has neither a price indicator nor a presence indicator, and a satellite look at Google's pin (Esri, 2026-11-12) shows a shop yard and a farmstead with no laid-out RV pads. The HHS listing alone does not make a live campground.

name: Golden Lake Acres
why: 2026-11-12: Golden Lake Acres (13648 11 St NE, Hatton; ND HHS 07.17.2025: GOLDEN LAKE ACRES, owner Dickson, Jacob, 48 units) is a private resort (bar/restaurant, store, beach) with RV spaces, but it has no website (Google lists only facebook.com/goldenlakeacres, which shows nothing without a login), no posted rate anywhere, no booking site, and is on neither RV Life (Algolia park index, nothing within 40 km but city parks) nor Good Sam (directory cache 2026-10-02, nothing within ~30 km). Presence passes (Google: RV park, 4.5 on 160 reviews, 701-963-3011, reviews mostly about the bar and burgers), but the private-park price indicator fails, and as a likely seasonal park it also fails long-stay test 2 (no nightly rate on its own website and no booking site). Steele County's Attractions page (undated) says only 'RV spaces with electricity and sewer, along with space for tents' and 'Come check out the new RV campground!' with no price.
